_howto: Fuel tours. steps = page tour. sections = one tour per screen plus pop-up form tours. Guides in fueldashboard_guides.json.
title: Fuel tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Fuel
steps.text:
Track every litre: from delivery into your tanks, through each pump, to the vehicle and the job it was used for, with trips, deliveries, efficiency and diesel rebate reports.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All screens
steps.text: Set up in this order: Settings, Management (farms, activities, prices), Fuel Depots, Vehicles, then Drivers.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.text: Fuel used, costs, efficiency and tank levels at a glance, with a map of where fuel was dispensed.

steps.title: Fuel Logs
steps.text: Every fuel issue: which vehicle, driver, pump and activity, how many litres, and the odometer or hours.

steps.title: Fueling Data
steps.text: The fuel logs as a table to filter, check and export.

steps.title: Trip Logs
steps.text: Trips captured on the mobile app, with distance and the activity.

steps.title: Deliveries
steps.text: Deliveries and collections made by drivers, with proof of delivery.

steps.title: Vehicles
steps.text: Your fleet and other fuelled assets, with license and service checks.

steps.title: Drivers
steps.text: Drivers with their license and PDP, and the user they log in as.

steps.title: Fuel Depots
steps.text: Your tanks and their pumps, levels, refills and transfers.

steps.title: Inventory
steps.text: Fuel stock in the warehouse: stock in, stock out and history.

steps.title: Management
steps.text: Farms and units, fuel activities, farming departments, trip activities, clients, sub-contractors, fuel prices and delivery setup.

steps.title: Intel Reports
steps.text: Consumption, efficiency, diesel rebate and exception reports.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: What the mobile app must capture, how efficiency is shown, and delivery rules.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Your profile, other areas of the system, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, and how-to guides such as adding a vehicle or a depot.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Add Asset
steps.text: A vehicle, tractor, generator or other machine that gets fuel. Tracked in kilometres or hours.

steps.title: Find an asset
steps.text: Search, or filter by type.

steps.title: License and Service Audits
steps.text: Which licenses are expiring and which assets are due for a service, exportable to Excel.

steps.title: Your fleet
steps.text: Each asset with its tag, type, current reading and service status. Edit one to change its details.

steps.title: Add New Driver
steps.text: Name, ID number, license number and code, license and PDP expiry, and the user they log in to the mobile app as.

steps.title: Driver Roster
steps.text: Every driver with their license status. Edit, deactivate or restore one.

steps.title: Add Depot / Tank
steps.text: A tank with its fuel type and size, and the pumps connected to it with their meter readings.

steps.title: Your tanks
steps.text: Each tank's level, pumps and meters. Record a refill, a manual dip reading, or a transfer between tanks.

steps.title: Your lists
steps.text: Farms and units, fuel activities, farming departments, trip activities, delivery clients, sub-contractors, fuel prices and delivery setup.

steps.title: Farms and field units
steps.text: The same farms and units as Production Pay: add them with their map location.

steps.title: Fuel activities
steps.text: What fuel is used for, such as Ploughing or Spraying. Tick rebate for activities that qualify for the diesel rebate.

steps.title: Fuel Pricing
steps.text: The price per litre from a date. A price can be entered for an earlier date too; costs from that date use it.

steps.title: What the app must capture
steps.text: Whether the odometer and a photo are required when fuel is issued, whether farming departments show, and the default road type. Each switch saves straight away.

steps.title: How efficiency is shown
steps.text: Kilometres per litre or litres per kilometre, and litres per hour or hours per litre.

steps.title: Deliveries
steps.text: What drivers must capture on a delivery (photo, proof, signatures), and when the electronic proof of delivery is emailed.
